image_description: A top-down close-up view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping, transversely ribbed calcareous plates. The plates exhibit a mottled pattern of brown, cream, and green hues. The background consists of dark, textured rock with patches of pink coralline algae.
